# Exit <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Exit
```

## Description

Leaves the closest loop ([For](For), [While](While) or [Repeat](Repeat)) and continues after it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For i = 1 To 10
	If i = 3 Then Exit
	Print i
Next
Print "done"
```

```text
1
2
done
```
